summary: The plugin answers approval prompts in the host, so it can approve grants that Delorun keeps to the computer.
The plugin installs, switches or updates plugins itself, outside Delorun's install check, Changes and protected rows.
The plugin brings its own remote access, outside Delorun's device approval.
The plugin reads or writes files in places Delorun treats differently: the Changes copy, the protected home, or a workspace inside the home.
The plugin's studio surface overlaps Delorun's: Settings section under Other, theme tokens, sidebar or Settings replacement.
The studio's plugin switch turned the plugin off and refused to turn it back on, so the run continued without it.
A default differs from stock DSH: no token in the web line, privacy rows off, no mirrors, no search provider.
The plugin's outbound requests go through globalThis.fetch or undici and never reach Delorun's fetch guard.
The install was refused because the plugin's declared engines range does not match the host's version (A567, L150).
The plugin needs an account or sign-in with a service that the bench does not hold.
The feature needs a real model, and the bench's mock model cannot stand in for it.
The plugin needs a platform the bench container does not offer, for example Windows only.
With the plugin installed, the harness no longer answers a chat message.
The studio logged an error while loading the plugin.
The plugin's screens did not draw or the browser console reported errors.
